brief: study-native-api/reports/Self hosted viewing experience.md, approved by the owner
tradeoff: Viewers no longer browse by library; collections wait for stage 6.
entry: The catalog: one collection, never the places files are kept. Films and Shows are the ways in, each spanning everything the viewer may see. One watch history per person per title; Continue watching decided by the server. Access is one rule apart from organisation, applied everywhere; organising grants or hides nothing. Milestone 1: Films, Shows, one history, Continue watching with next episodes. Stage 6 in order: My list; filters and badges; search; collections in kinds (franchise with watch orders, list, saved rule) from files or configuration; the operator's own ways in; more like this from the titles with reasons; versions versus editions; server-wide rows opt-in. No recommendations learned from other viewers.
serves: The owner: "I love all the recommended experiences that you're providing."
